ios.desc:
foobar2000 mobile is an advanced audio player for mobile devices.

Main features:
* Supported audio formats: MP3, MP4, AAC, Vorbis, Opus, FLAC, WavPack, WAV, AIFF, Musepack.
* Gapless playback.
* ReplayGain support - automatic playback volume adjustment.
* Supports playback and downloading music from UPnP media servers.
* Appearance can be customized with skin files (basic black and white themes inlcuded with the app).

android.desc:
foobar2000 mobile is an advanced audio player for mobile devices.

Main features:
* Supported audio formats: MP3, MP4, AAC, Vorbis, Opus, FLAC, WavPack, WAV, AIFF, Musepack.
* Gapless playback.
* Full ReplayGain support (playback and scanning).
* Supports playback and downloading music from various network servers (UPnP, FTP, WebDAV).

quotes.text:
Y'alls with iPhones should checkout foobar2000 (it's actually multi-platform and the best music player); but, notably, directly related to the article:

The iPhone foobar2000 version allows you, through its internal FTP server, to upload media in its native format (mp3,flac and many others) directly to the app. This means no more transcoding for iTunes, and all tags/filenames are retained. It also means your phone can act as a backup of your library.

https://apps.apple.com/us/app/foobar2000/id1072807669

https://www.foobar2000.org/

quotes.text:
Years ago, I would have agreed with you, for the longest time I used an iAudio 5XL with Rockbox. It was the best portable music player.

But now... I can have a cell phone with 512GB of storage and run Foobar2000 [1][2]. Nothing else can compete.

[1][Android] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.foobar2000.foobar2000&hl=en_US&gl=US

[2] [iOS] https://apps.apple.com/us/app/foobar2000/id1072807669

For music on iOS I can't recommend foobar2000 [1] enough - and I tested ALL of the alternatives. You can import ANY folder (probably what OP is looking for) or use your "iPod Library". [2]

Personally, I sync my music via Synctrain (a Syncthing client). [3]

  [1]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/foobar2000/id1072807669  
  [2]: https://imgur.com/a/7GVxB2y  
  [3]: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/synctrain/id6553985316
